evidence_status: preregistered end-to-end meta-outer OOF validation; inner safety selection remains training-side stacking rather than a separately untouched test
hypothesis: the frozen v2.7 one-action portfolio selector retains a zero-harm HR@10 gain when every upstream ranker, current admission gate, focused cohort, and selector component is rebuilt without the evaluated outer product-family fold
unique_variable: replace globally frozen proposal/current training surfaces with domain-local strict outer-restacked surfaces; v2.7 action features, labels, model, weights, utility, tie-break, chronological latch, quantile grid, and promotion objective are unchanged

domain_algebra.inner_partition: the five V_oj are disjoint and cover T_o exactly
required_checks: every product family maps to one outer and one inner fold
H_o and every training domain are disjoint
all masks are hashed with counts and canonical descriptors
every scored session has exactly one recorded training-domain lineage

claim_boundary.guaranteed: for each final held outer fold H_o, no H_o label, target, cohort state, current-policy outcome, or feature row enters any v2.8 ranker, gate, threshold, cohort, or selector fit used to score H_o
claim_boundary.standard_stacking: each T_o session receives one base OOF prediction from the A_oj model that excluded its own inner fold; the selector trains on those OOF rows
claim_boundary.not_claimed: selector-inner validation j is not a third-level independently untouched test because base OOF models for other inner rows can use V_oj labels; only the final H_o result is promoted evidence
claim_boundary.historical_adaptivity: fixed boosting rounds come from already-recorded pre-v2.8 research and therefore this remains adaptive train_explore evidence, not a never-touched external test

generic_training.training_groups: the frozen complete 40-row grouped ranking rows, masked by whole session/product family
generic_training.fixed_round_source: frozen pre-v2.8 deployed tree count or median historical best_iteration plus one; no v2.8 round sweep

common_parameters.xgboost_1_7_6_limitation: lambdarank_pair_method is unavailable and is not passed

seed.repeat_rule: the same model id and canonical domain must receive the same seed in both passes

generic_training.prediction: Booster output_margin=true over semantic-off C100 rows
generic_training.model_count_per_pass: 4 generic models times (25 A_oj domains plus 5 T_o domains) = 120

domain_local_current_policy.T_o_gate_oof: for each j, train both heads only on the assembled T_o current-ranker OOF action surface restricted to A_oj sessions, then score V_oj; never use A_oj full-model in-sample scores or the globally frozen current surface
domain_local_current_policy.heads: the frozen current rescue and reciprocal-rank-regret L2 logistic definitions
domain_local_current_policy.preprocessing: the frozen current weighted training/preprocessing implementation
domain_local_current_policy.inner_quantile: select once from the five T_o gate-OOF utilities using the frozen 0/64..63/64+KEEP safety rule
domain_local_current_policy.T_o_activation: apply the selected inner threshold to the assembled T_o OOF utilities
domain_local_current_policy.held_current: fit both heads on all T_o OOF action rows; use the full-T_o current ranker on T_o reference and H_o; map the selected quantile on unlabeled T_o reference utility and score H_o
domain_local_current_policy.held_comparator: the pre-v2.8 frozen current OOF policy is used only as the secondary final deployment baseline, never as a v2.8 training feature or focused-cohort input
domain_local_current_policy.keep_semantics: KEEP preserves the domain-local held current policy bit-for-bit

focused_training.cohort_source: domain-local T_o current OOF state only
focused_training.hard: T_o current miss with an eligible target in the allowed-91 set
focused_training.control: T_o current first-hit rank10 session with an eligible allowed target no later than first hit
focused_training.weights: within-session normalization followed by exact 50/50 hard-control balance inside each actual A_oj or T_o training partition
focused_training.model: the frozen v2.5 depth-3 rank:ndcg Booster, 300 fixed rounds, nthread=1
focused_training.inner: train each A_oj cohort and score V_oj
focused_training.outer: train the T_o cohort and score both T_o reference and H_o
focused_training.forbidden: reuse of the global v2.5 hard/control cohort

portfolio_and_selector.rrf3: fixed equal-weight stable-rank RRF(k=60) of domain-local current/d6/regularized scores
portfolio_and_selector.action: deduplicate three family proposals by candidate and exclude domain-local current served choice and P11 incumbent
portfolio_and_selector.labels: the exact frozen isolated current-relative rescue and composite RR/MTTC regret definitions
portfolio_and_selector.model: the exact frozen two C=0.2 liblinear L2 logistic heads with v2.7 session-normalized weights
portfolio_and_selector.inner_selection: the exact v2.7 fixed quantile grid, readiness, aggregate/every-inner safety, and selection key on T_o OOF actions
portfolio_and_selector.outer_mapping: fit heads on T_o OOF actions, score the target-free T_o full-model reference surface, map the selected quantile over per-turn winners, then score H_o
portfolio_and_selector.runtime_policy: within-turn utility/support/candidate tie-break followed by chronological first-passing latch; at most one supplement per session

two_stage_execution.stage_0: for outer o=0, train and repeat the five current A_0j models and score each V_0j; assemble the T_0 current-ranker OOF surface; construct the five current gate folds, select the frozen-rule current quantile, and derive the T_0 current OOF state; then train and repeat the A_00 pairwise, d6, regularized, and focused models and score V_00. This is nine ranker fits per pass. T_0 labels may be used only as training-side supervision for the current gate and focused cohort; no H_0 label may be accessed and no V_00 proposal/selector rescue, harm, or policy outcome metric may be computed or reported
two_stage_execution.stage_0_gate: all nine model/score/slot10-choice hashes repeat exactly, all lineage/group/parity/privacy checks pass, hard_groups(A_00)>0 and control_groups(A_00)>0, projected values are finite, and the explicit H_0 label-access counter remains zero
stage_1_topology: for each o, train all current A_oj models and assemble current-ranker OOF predictions over T_o
fit the five current gate folds from T_o OOF action rows, select the current quantile, and freeze the domain-local T_o current OOF state
derive every A_oj and T_o focused hard/control cohort exclusively from that T_o current OOF state; fail closed unless both cohorts are nonempty in every actual training partition
train and score the A_oj pairwise, d6, regularized, and focused models to assemble selector-training OOF proposals over T_o
train the T_o current, pairwise, d6, regularized, and focused models; fit the full-T_o current heads; score the target-free T_o reference and H_o surfaces
fit/select the frozen v2.7 selector on T_o OOF actions, map its quantile on the target-free T_o full-model reference surface, and apply it to H_o once
two_stage_execution.stage_1: only after Stage 0 passes, execute the complete topology for all outer folds twice, freeze every target-free cache and manifest, pass all mechanical gates, and only then attach held labels for one selector/outcome evaluation
two_stage_execution.large_outputs: gitignored model/score/surface cache; tracked manifests contain only paths, domains, shapes, counts, timing, and hashes

promotion_gate.required_reporting_only: report domain-local current versus frozen current separately so upstream ranker/gate changes cannot be attributed to the selector

stop_rule.mechanics_failure: record IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE and repair only the violated preregistered mechanic before any outcome
stop_rule.outcome_failure: close strict-restacked one-action selector without changing rounds, cohorts, models, features, weights, utility, folds, readiness, quantiles, or latch
stop_rule.outcome_pass: authorize only full-data model/artifact freeze and target-free parity/resource benchmark; do not open calibration, selection, confirmation, public, or full Agent evaluator
stop_rule.oracle: report only after the strict result is frozen; never use target reachability to filter domains, rows, models, or thresholds
